acceptanceCriteria: A test places a duplicate of a prefix request in the tail and asserts refusal on the fast route.
Fix keeps the fast route cost bounded.
body:
Parent: V1-0645. Observed: walkTail does not detect a tail request file that duplicates a request already in the verified prefix. Expected: duplicate request id across prefix and tail is refused (REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT or documented equivalent). Found by review in the V1-0645 lane; confirm with a reproducing test first.

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).

title: V1-0645: walkTail misses a tail request file that duplicates a prefix request
